vulnerability_context: The CoinToken contract at 0xCA54954bb4E1b35AeE6eB04130CD406340EBA9B4 has a privileged function `EnemyAddress` that can be called by the owner to blacklist any address. The vulnerability is the centralized power of the owner to block addresses at will.
winning_reflection: The key insight was recognizing that the contract's blacklist functionality was an unprotected, owner-privileged action. By impersonating the contract's owner, it was possible to directly invoke the `EnemyAddress` function to add an arbitrary address to the internal `_isEnemy` blacklist.
